signature: AActor* GetClosestActorFromArray(const TArray<AActor*>& ArrayOfActors, AActor* Actor)

callees.0x141ef10f0: helper: returns the array element nearest to Actor by squared root-component distance; first minimum wins; null when empty

notes: The native loop is unrolled by four; its semantics are the plain loop above. Location reads are the component location fields at 0x1d0..0x1d8 of the root component.
